summary: V38F tested — backend share-link + rename + public download, and frontend ShareSheet UI. All 10 backend tests pass (10/10). ShareSheet UI works: all 5 testIDs render, link is generated with /api/public/files/<token>, '24h' badge shown, Copia link copies the proper public URL to clipboard. Fixed one CRITICAL backend bug: share-link URL was returning internal cluster host instead of public preview URL (recipients got 403). Added X-Forwarded-Proto/Host support in POST /api/contacts/{cid}/files/{fid}/share-link so the URL uses the ingress-visible host. Not tested: auto-save on Report/Comparison (needs seeded bills — skipped per instructions).

Optional: consider adding a rate limit / abuse throttle on POST /api/contacts/{cid}/files/{fid}/share-link (currently unlimited — any authenticated user with visibility can mint tokens repeatedly).

rca_of_issue: Symptom: share link fetched without auth returned 403 Forbidden from the response, even though the endpoint code has no auth dependency and bogus/expired tokens correctly returned 400/410. Reproduction: 1) POST /api/contacts/{cid}/files/{fid}/share-link → response url = http://contact-hub-italy.cluster-7.preview.emergentcf.cloud/api/public/files/<jwt>. 2) GET that URL → 403 from cluster ingress (internal DNS, not exposed externally). 3) Rewriting host to https://contact-hub-italy.preview.emergentagent.com and GETting → 200 with expected bytes + Content-Disposition. Root cause: FastAPI's request.base_url reflects the internal host the app was hit from (uvicorn behind ingress) — not the ingress-facing public URL. Mitigation: read X-Forwarded-Proto and X-Forwarded-Host headers (added by the ingress) and fall back to request.base_url when absent. Verified: all 10 pytest cases pass after fix, and the browser flow now shows a working public URL in the ShareSheet.
